title: Design for Oil Well 12 Rehabilitation
short_description: Design services for rehabilitation of an existing municipal oil well in Newport Beach.
project_scope: Rehabilitation design for Oil Well No. 12, one of 16 city-owned oil wells constructed between 1953 and 1958. The project funds maintenance and repairs intended to extend service life and maintain production. No technical dimensions, capacities, or structural spans are stated.
services: Consulting and design services; requested disciplines include architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, environmental engineering/planning/design, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Oil well rehabilitation is not within sbp's core focus areas such as bridges, long-span roofs, special lightweight structures, or major buildings.
- The notice is for a general industrial maintenance/rehabilitation project with no indication of architecturally or structurally demanding features.
- Includes structural engineering, but the overall scope is dominated by oil well maintenance and multidisciplinary consulting.
- Advance notice only; no detailed planning scope, structural challenge, or innovation aspects are described.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. Only a contract value of 250000 USD appears to refer to the consultant/design contract, not the construction works.
fee_explanation: Taken from the tender documents as stated contract value; this appears to be the consultant/design contract value.
references_qualifications: No specific reference requirements or bidder qualifications are stated in the notice beyond requested disciplines: architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, environmental engineering/planning/design, and structural engineering.
contracting_authority: City of Newport Beach, Newport Beach, California, USA. Contact: Mark Vukojevic. Email: cityclerk@newportbeachca.gov. Phone: 949-644-3311. Fax: 949-644-3318.
notes: Advance notice only. RFQ/RFP package expected prior to 2027-07-01. Target market listed as General Building. Project concerns municipal oil well infrastructure, which is outside sbp's typical target sectors. Source states Project #863983, ProjectID 1006476, DR# 202600204303.
